apps.name: Clearline
apps.subtitle: Private offline-first task management for iPhone and Windows.
apps.localizedDescription: Clearline is a private, offline-first task manager with native iPhone integrations, widgets and controls, Share Sheet capture, Shortcuts/App Intents, reminders, calendar interoperability, and encrypted cross-device synchronization.

versions.localizedDescription: Physical-iPhone cache-busting retest candidate, build 2. Built from dual-green source commit b5c188c687cdf4dbfe7bf8354f9c603d7210e80e. Main app web bundle, version metadata, URL/privacy/background properties, Widgets/Controls extension, and Share extension passed remote and direct IPA verification.
